fields.name: form-title
fields.label: Form Title
fields.description: Heading shown above the slots. Leave empty to use "Schedule a consultation".

fields.name: slots-label
fields.label: Slots Label
fields.description: Line above the slot picker. Leave empty to use "Next Available Slots".

fields.name: submit-label
fields.label: Submit Label
fields.description: Button text. Leave empty to use "Schedule Call".

fields.name: time-slots
fields.label: Time Slots (comma-separated)
fields.description: Comma-separated list of time slots shown each day

fields.name: days-shown
fields.label: Days Shown
fields.description: Number of day columns to display at once (1-7)

fields.name: mobile-days-shown
fields.label: Mobile Days Shown
fields.description: Number of day columns to display at once for mobile (1-7)

fields.name: redirect-url
fields.label: Redirect URL (after submit)
fields.description: Optional page to redirect to 2 seconds after successful submission

fields.name: buttondata
fields.label: Button Data Sheet
fields.description: AEM sheet path whose key/value rows are sent on submit

fields.name: mobileRedirectUrl
fields.label: Mobile Redirect URL
fields.description: Page the app opens after a successful submit. Leave empty to stay on the form.
